title: Quantum Feature Selection for Biomedical Data Analysis
summary: Feature selection is an essential step for reducing complexity of high dimensional data, usually in preparation for developing machine learning models such as computational biomarkers. However, there are limitations associated with feature selection such as for metabolomic data where there are hundreds or even thousands of features per study participant, while the available number of participants in a clinical trials is limited.
